boom.travel_authority: 3.604 m telescope-cylinder stroke is evidence-derived; second-section +3.604 m and chained third-section additional +3.604 m are the visual chain relationship. The parallel extend paths and center retract path use reconstructed sheave radii/anchors and invariant tangent U-routes; no manufacturer chain length is claimed. Authored origins and the zero-degree ground-clear stow remain reconstructed

frame_level.authority: published function and limit; pivot coordinates reconstructed

steering.linkage: one fixed double-ended cylinder barrel, one continuous translated opposed-rod rack, and two invariant steering bars per axle
steering.authority: published modes, wheelbase, and outside turning radius plus service-manual 55 degree limit. Wheel-center track, rack stroke, steering-arm anchors, and the resulting linkage curve are reconstructed. The published outside-radius reference locus and tire/body swept-envelope convention are unresolved, so 3.66 m is reported independently and is not equated to the reconstructed swept envelope

carriage.authority: published attachment topology and 2.36 x 4 x 48 in fork selection; the exact 48 in length is 1.2192 m while 1200 mm is the rounded metric label. Displayed pivot travel and the ground-clear zero-degree stow are reconstructed

reach_pose.authority: published reach and 24 inch load center; selected 3 degree visual pose is reconstructed. Validation derives the front tire tread plane from the posed GLB geometry rather than a coordinate constant

collision_proxies.ground_clearance_authority: published approximate ground clearance; exact manufacturer component locus is unresolved, so validation uses the named reconstructed rigid-underbody proxy set with grounded tires
